entries.zh: 凭准（凭证、证书；准许、依据之凭据）
entries.en: certificate, credential; written warrant or authorization (proof)

entries.zh: 伤痕（伤口之痕；皮肤划痕、线条之记）
entries.en: mark of a wound; scratch or line-mark on the skin

entries.zh: 班（行列、班组、班次；通「斑」，条纹、斑痕）
entries.en: squad, row, shift (muster roll); stripe or streak-mark (also written 斑)

entries.zh: 数码记号、记数之符（汉字难辨，释义存疑）
entries.en: numeral sign, numerical mark (doubtful)
entries.notes: 汉字栏仅存疑字（癠/疵），音 chue 与西语「numeral」难以互证，语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 疤（久愈成熟疮疡所留之疤）
entries.en: scar; mark left by an old, healed sore (cicatrix)
entries.notes: 「ç madura」按旧拼写当读 çicatriz madura（成熟旧疮疤）

entries.zh: 痕（旧疤或伤口之痕迹）
entries.en: trace, mark; scar-mark of an old sore or wound

entries.zh: 惊叹之记号（惊叹号）；惊骇、惊叹
entries.en: mark of astonishment (the exclamation sign); astonishment, to marvel, be amazed

entries.zh: 跡（足迹、辙迹；行迹所留之痕）
entries.en: footprint, track; trace left by passage

entries.zh: 蹤（踪迹、足迹）
entries.en: trace, footprint, track

entries.zh: 下定（下聘定婚之礼；付定钱、给定物为信）
entries.en: to give the betrothal pledge (earnest gift); to pay earnest money, give a token in pledge

entries.zh: 聘钗（下聘所赠之钗；婚约定礼、合意之信物）
entries.en: betrothal hairpin given as pledge; token of betrothal accord
entries.notes: 首字存疑（娉/聘）；西语 inteligencia 当指婚约合意；M 第二音节 iey 与「釵」音不合，存疑

entries.zh: 蹤跡（足迹、行踪之痕）
entries.en: footprint, track, trace

entries.zh: 更鼓（打更报时之鼓；守夜人四更打毕之号）
entries.en: night watch-drum; the sentry's signal when the fourth watch is ended

entries.zh: 杨梅疮（梅毒）之征候；疮疡溃漏
entries.en: sign of the pox (syphilis); foul sores with discharge
entries.notes: bubas＝梅毒；H「乾漏」疑当为「疳漏」（下疳溃漏），与西语难以直证

entries.zh: 敲枋（击板为号；出堂赴审时先敲板示众）
entries.en: to knock the wooden board (clapper) as the signal for going out to the audience (court session)

entries.zh: 痘迹（天花痘斑、麻点之痕）
entries.en: smallpox marks, pockmarks
entries.notes: 首字存疑（瘠/癠），据西语 viruelas（天花）定释义

entries.zh: 斑点（天花痘斑点点、痘痕）
entries.en: spots, pockmarks (smallpox marks)

entries.zh: 疤痣（疮疤与黑痣；身上之记）
entries.en: scars and moles; marks of a wound or old sore

entries.zh: 班班（斑斑；痘斑点点，天花之痕）
entries.en: spots (reduplicated pan-pan); pockmarks of smallpox
entries.notes: 西语 para 与 viruelas 同指天花；H 第二字残，据叠音「pan pan」补为班班（斑斑）

entries.zh: 表记（爱情之信物、纪念标记）
entries.en: love token, keepsake; mark of remembrance

entries.zh: 表意（表露心意；情爱之表示）
entries.en: expression of feeling; token of affection
entries.notes: M 第二音节残，据 H「表意」及前后条（表記、表情）补足释义

entries.zh: 表情（表露情意、传情；情爱之表记）
entries.en: expression of affection, declaration of love
